label: meaningful
label_meaning: meaningful: built from the seller's own published schema

distanceKm.description: Distance from the requested lat/lng to the station used; only present when resolved by lat/lng

heightFt.description: Observed water level in feet above MLLW; present only when product=water_level

preliminary.description: True if the reading is preliminary/unverified; present only when product=water_level

tides.description: High/low tide predictions for the next 48 hours; present only when product=predictions

time.description: Observation time (GMT); present only when product=water_level

attribution.derived_from: the schema and example output the seller publicly lists there
attribution.status: unclaimed: the owner can claim or remove the matching listing on the discovery board
